QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Subjective Morality
QuestInfo.0: #bKrania#k is going to try and escape with her research!\r\nSpeak with #bSpencer#k and form a plan for pursuit!
QuestInfo.1: #bSpencer#k tells you that #bKrania#k has gone to the \n#bdeepest part of the Aspire complex#k.\r\nDefeat #bScion#k, the lab's central control system, and apprehend Krania!
QuestInfo.2: You destroyed the Scion mainframe and confronted #bKrania#k. After refusing to concede any flaw in her methods, she made her escape.\r\nNow, a decision must be made about the abandoned Wondroids.

0.msg: #h0#, you need to chase after #bKrania#k!\r\nWe have to destroy the #bScion#k mainframe and apprehend her!
